_comment: Desktop macOS regression — 1 of 3 same-named 'Desktop' runs distinguished only by Testmo Configuration. This is the BROAD variant: the whole Desktop top-level folder (folder id 2923) and all descendants with the established defaults (Smoke/Regression, Active, manual only). The Windows and Linux siblings are narrow instead, scoped to the 'desktop-essential' tag. TWO-STEP RUN — the API only reproduces step 1. STEP 2 IS MANUAL: after creating this run, in the Testmo UI clear the filters, select Configuration = Windows and then Linux, and REMOVE those cases from the run. Reason: Testmo's /cases API cannot filter by configuration and exposes no per-case config assignment, same limitation documented on the Mobile specs. config_id 21 = MacOS (verified 2026-08-28).
